title: Investigating and Alleviating Harm Amplification in LLM Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2606.02423v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can serve as helpful assistants, yet they can equally function as harm amplifiers that enable malicious users to achieve harmful outcomes beyond their capabilities through extended interactions. This risk manifests along two axes, i.e., democratizing domain expertise that allows novices to produce specialized harmful content, and scaling harmful operations at volumes that manual effort cannot match. Existing works, however, often overlook how LLMs compound harm across multi-turn conversations. We introduce HarmAmp, a new benchmark for multi-turn harm amplification scenarios spanning twelve risk categories. Each scenario is grounded in real-world threats and satisfies rigorous criteria, i.e., substantive amplification, operational specificity, and multi-turn necessity. We further propose TrajSafe, a proactive monitor that anticipates harmful trajectories and intervenes through actions such as probing users

translated_title: 研究与缓解大语言模型交互中的危害放大问题
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以充当有用的助手，但它们同样可能成为危害放大器，使恶意用户通过持续的交互获得超出其自身能力范围的有害结果。这种风险体现在两个维度上：一是领域专长的民主化，使新手也能生成专业性的有害内容；二是有害操作的规模化，其规模是人工操作无法企及的。然而，现有研究往往忽视了大语言模型如何在多轮对话中逐步累积危害。我们提出了HarmAmp，一个针对多轮危害放大场景的新基准，涵盖十二个风险类别。每个场景都植根于现实世界的威胁，并满足严格的标准，即实质性放大、操作具体性和多轮必要性。我们进一步提出了TrajSafe，一种主动式监控器，能够预判有害的交互轨迹，并通过诸如探询用户等动作进行干预。
tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型在多轮对话中逐步放大危害的问题，提出了涵盖十二个风险类别的HarmAmp基准，并设计了能预判有害交互轨迹并主动干预的监控器TrajSafe。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HarmAmp, a new benchmark for multi-turn harm amplification spanning twelve risk categories, and proposes TrajSafe, a proactive monitor that anticipates harmful trajectories and intervenes in LLM interactions.
